tools.name: create_plan
tools.description: Create a new saved lesgooo plan with shareable links. Optionally adds the first participant and returns their private participant_token. Does not send invitations or notifications. Do not call this tool when the user says they are under 13 (or a known higher local minimum), even with a nickname: exp

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Change the shared event everyone sees on the RSVP page: title, date/time, place or description. Only after the group agreed. Times are local (no time zone); omit start_time for an all-day event. Send only the fields to change; an empty string clears a field. Current stored state is available through

tools.name: get_expenses
tools.description: Read the plan's shared costs (Splitwise tab): expenses, each person's balance, and the suggested payments to settle up. Amounts are in the plan's currency.

tools.name: add_expense
tools.description: Record a shared expense, split equally. paid_by defaults to the person you act for; split_among defaults to everyone in the plan. tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Record that the person you act for paid someone back (settling up). amount defaults to what they owe that person according to get_expenses. Only after the money was actually sent. Do not call this tool when the user says they are under 13 (or a known higher local minimum), even with a nickname: expl

tools.name: remove_entry
tools.description: Delete an expense, payment, checklist item or place that the person you act for added (e.g. to fix a wrong amount: remove, then add again). Entries added by others can't be removed here. Requires an explicit request to delete this specific entry. Do not call this tool when the user says they are und

tools.name: widget_write
tools.description: App-only transport for explicit interactions with shared web components. Reuses the web write gateway, validation and budgets. Requires the selected participant token for saved-plan edits.

tools.name: widget_select_participant
tools.description: App-only identity picker. Bind the name explicitly selected in the shared web UI. Does not change schedule data.

tools.name: widget_lookup
tools.description: App-only Places search/details and link previews. The backend retains feature flags, monthly provider counters and timeouts. Never calls a paid API from the browser.

tools.name: open_planner
tools.description: Open the interactive lesgooo planner. Optionally choose a saved plan link and module. Without a plan, show the same local draft as the web application; never save a shared plan automatically.

tools.name: find_plan_mentions
tools.description: Resolve an explicitly supplied lesgooo saved-plan link or exact ID for the desktop mention picker. Empty or general searches return no results; never enumerate plans.

tools.name: open_preferences
tools.description: Open local widget preferences. Defaults and recent history stay on this device; does not change a shared plan.

tools.name: read_plugin_settings
tools.description: Read the plugin settings layout. There are no account settings; the action opens device-local preferences.

tools.name: update_plugin_settings
tools.description: No primitive account settings are available. An empty update is a no-op; device preferences are changed in the widget.

tools.name: collect_plan_details
tools.description: Ask the user for missing availability, RSVP, place, expense or agreed event details in a native form. Returns selected values only; NEVER changes a plan. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_plan · Private data: create_plan, join_plan, set_availability, set_rsvp, add_place, vote_place, add_checklist_item, check_item, update_event, add_expense, record_payment, remove_entry, widget_write · Public sink: create_plan, get_plan, update_event · Destructive: set_availability, set_rsvp, vote_place, remove_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_plan · Private data: create_plan, join_plan, set_availability, set_rsvp, add_place, vote_place, add_checklist_item, check_item, update_event, add_expense, record_payment, remove_entry, widget_write · Public sink: create_plan, get_plan, update_event · Destructive: set_availability, set_rsvp, vote_place, remove_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
